svg.aria-label: Conceptual curve, not data. A teal S-curve of how much infrastructure gets built rises through: it arrives, it booms fast, fear peaks, only what pays gets built, life adapts, flattening under a dashed coral ceiling labelled power, water, land, capital, permits and demand.
svg.text: the shape of the argument · not a dataset
the governor: power · water · land · capital · permits · demand
the ceiling is not fixed: engineering and policy move it up or down
